title: Functional Renormalization Group as a Ricci Flow: An \(\mathcal{F}\)-Entropy Perspective on Information Metric Dynamics
summary: We establish a geometric correspondence between the Functional Renormalization Group (FRG) and a Ricci flow modified by a potential-driven diffeomorphism. By rewriting the Polchinski exact RG equation as an infinite-dimensional Fokker--Planck equation for field-distribution functionals, we show how a probability flow driven by a ``thermodynamic'' free-energy functional induces the evolution of the Fisher information metric on the coupling-constant manifold.
